content.text:
No. `src/services/user-service.js` still calls `query` and `update` from `db.js` directly, using callbacks. It doesn't import `UserRepository`. The comment at `src/services/user-service.js:3` says so too: "Chapter 5 migrates this to UserRepository."

The repository it would switch to, `src/repositories/user-repository.js`, already exists and has a promise-based method for each service function:

| user-service.js (callback) | UserRepository (promise) |
|---|---|
| `listActiveUsers(cb)` | `findActive()` |
| `findUser(id, cb)` | `findById(id)` |
| `softDeleteUser(id, when, cb)` | `softDelete(id, when)` |

The project has a `migrate-module` skill that converts one service to its repository and then runs that service's tests. I can run it on `user-service.js` if you want.
